text.title: FreshDrop business model, September 2026
text.partners: local farms and a courier fleet partner; produce at cost
text.activities: picking and packing, route planning, quality checks
text.resources: dark stores in 6 districts, courier app, stock data
text.value: a full weekly grocery list in 2 hours, with live stock
text.relationships: weekly reminder, personal substitutes chat, loyalty points
text.channels: app search and referral codes; order in app; delivery to the door
text.segments: busy families in new districts, aged 30–40
text.costs: courier pay 38%, dark-store rent 22%, marketing 12% of revenue
text.revenues: basket fee per order, delivery fee below 1 500 ₽, card payment
